notes: Each table maps raw parameter data (index) to the displayed value. values[i] corresponds to data = first_index + i (first_index is 0 except where the printed table starts at 1, 4 or 14). Every table was checked to have contiguous, in-order data indices.
Values are strings exactly as printed (units included where printed, e.g. "-60.0 dB", "1.0k", "THRU (20)").
Table numbers 1-74 are all present; the PDF prints "Table#71" without a space.
used_by_parameters is derived from the Tbl No. column of the Effect Parameter List.
